steps.instruction: Rename the Todo field `done: boolean` to `completed: boolean`. No other changes. Update any usage inside types.ts and its tests (if an existing test constructs a Todo with `done`, it must be changed — request that change). nextId behaviour unchanged.

The Todo type (from ./types) now has `completed: boolean` instead of `done: boolean`. Replace every use of `todo.done` with `todo.completed`. Rendered output must be exactly the same as before for the equivalent todo. Exported signatures are unchanged. If existing tests construct Todos with `done`, they need changing to `completed` — request that change.

The Todo type (from ./types) now has `completed: boolean` instead of `done: boolean`. Save writes todos with the `completed` key (no `done` key). For backward compatibility, load must convert any legacy record that has `done` but no `completed` into `completed: <done value>` and drop the `done` key. Signatures unchanged. If existing tests use `done`, they need changing to `completed` — request that change.

The Todo type (from ./types) now has `completed: boolean` instead of `done: boolean`. Replace every use: add() creates todos with `completed: false`, complete() sets `completed: true`, list() filters on `completed` (keep the ListOptions.includeDone option name and its semantics unchanged). Signatures unchanged; output text unchanged. If existing tests use `done` on Todo objects, they need changing to `completed` — request that change.
